title: Executor errors are errors, not grades
goal: An engine client spawn failure yields an error result, never failed
acceptance: A spawn failure makes the executor reject
Coding and OpenSCAD graders return error / executor-error on an executor rejection; runners report error
privacy: No data: runner and grader control flow only.
validation: Regression test committed failing first; npm test; CI
escalation: A change to the executor contract is an owner decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 when opened: one runner or grader change plus a regression test. Not a measurement.
